notes.title: Two "THANK YOUs" and one invitation from 'A Wake Inn' team
notes.content:
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41045288/ebecaa8000bf32c1400556a464ae2ee5a7d8e4b7.png

What's up everyone?

There's been a lot going on with 'A Wake Inn: Rebooked' recently, so we're letting you know what exactly.

First of all...

A HUGE THANK YOU (the first in this post!) to ALL OF YOU who visited our stand at Poznań Game Arena 2021 two weeks ago! We were visited by CROWDS of people, and we wanted to chat and hang out a little bit with each of you.
We met mostly gamers, but also journalists, influencers, developers, visual artists, hardware shop employees (who trurly sympathise with all those who want to buy a GPU at a reasonable price now...), students, moms and dads, linguists, authors and even... cardiac surgeons*! Making long story short... WE. MET. YOU!!! And it was GREAT experience for the entire 'A Wake Inn' team!
For every good word, hint, opinion - we thank you! Because of that we can now create a game that you - the players - want to play.

Our second 'thank you' goes to...

... the DreadXP crew and all of those who watched their Spooky Showcase, of which we were a part! We are very grateful that they included us in their livestream.
If any of you haven't yet watched Spooky Showcase 2021 you can do so here:
[previewyoutube=s3wl04A7ar4;full][/previewyoutube]


Last but not least!
From 6th of November we will be participating in the INDIE Live Expo, to which you are warmly invited! This festival is watched by almost 28 million people and the broadcast will be in 3 languages - Japanese, Chinese and English.
Keep an eye out and remember to watch the livestream on November 6 at 4:00 PM JST. Look out for 'A Wake Inn' there!
[previewyoutube=BiYqV3OKi00;full][/previewyoutube]

Remember to check out our Facebook, Twitter and Instagram, Wakelings!



--
Stay healthy and BOO! (well-we-are-late-a-little-bit-for-Halloween...)
VRBros



* And they are ALSO playing VR games. Like... for real, LOL!

notes.title: Poznań Game Arena (PGA) 2021? "A Wake Inn" team will be there!
notes.content:
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41045288/09a0e0d57bdaa7a6fb51d5931f7028c7f79793b0.png

Hey everyone!

We are very proud to announce that we will be present at the Poznań Game Arena 2021 fair, which will take place between 22nd and 24th of October in... well... Poznań, Poland!

If you want to meet our VRBros team, play the demo of our games (both "AWI: Rebooked" AND the VR version!), or simply hang out with us and chat about anything (not only A-Wake-Inn related!) - feel invited and just visit us at our PGA 2021 stand!

We are also prepering some other things for you there, but... you must check them out for yourselves!

Once again:

 Poznań Game Arena (PGA) 2021,
 22-24 of October,
 Poznań, Poland.

Make sure to be there, Wakelings!



More up-to-date news, details, announcements, etc. on our Facebook, Twitter and Instagram - remember to check them regularly!



--
Stay healthy. Visit PGA 2021.
VRBros

notes.title: Demo! Livestream!! Steam NEXT Fest is almost here!!!
notes.content:
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41045288/e7a81b616e356afa3edd5093f36d9185995b4e34.gif

'Hello' to every single one of you!

How are you? We hope everyting is just fine on the other side of the Internet! As promised about 3 weeks ago - we are getting back to you with a couple of very exciting news! We were (and we still are!) working very hard to deliver you the best possible experience of full immersion taken out from our VR version of the "A Wake Inn" straight to your PC screen.
But let's cut to the point, shall we...?

It's Steam NEXT Fest time...!
Yes. And we are taking a part in it! The NEXT Fest starts on the 1st of October and will last until October 7, 2021.
So what exactly does it mean to you? Couple of things, so let's start with...:

Demo!
We are very excited to finally share with all of you (and that's the part where you are getting all hyped up!) that our first public Demo version of "A Wake Inn: Rebooked" will be at last live and ready to play/test/check out by everyone of you!
When the festival will start, simply go to our product page and download the demo version: A Wake Inn: Rebooked Demo

We really hope you will like it!
And we would love to hear your feedback about our demo. To make it as convenient as possible for you - we created special forum on our Community Hub, where you will be able to post your opinions, thoughts and all of that what you are willing to share with us about the Demo.
You can find this special, demo-dedicated forum here: Steam NEXT Fest - Demo

Livestream!
There is some more. On the 1st of October we will have a special livestream of our Demo walkthrough, full-dev-commentary style! You will be able to watch how do we approach the gameplay, learn the features and mechanics of the standalone PC version of the game and - who knows - maybe you will discover something new...?

Make sure you follow our social media so you don't miss the start of the live stream!

We are leaving you - again: for now.
Please, enjoy the Steam NEXT Fest and have a great time with all of which we prepared for you!



--
Stay healthy... and (don't?) be scared
VRBros

notes.title: A Wake Inn: Rebooked - PC Announcement and the new trailer
notes.content:
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41045288/27277423b81b26bfeba3944584c19924f8934457.jpg

Hello!

After many months we can finally share that A Wake Inn is coming to a desktop PC as a standalone version called A Wake Inn: Rebooked! That's why we are presenting you a brand new (still hot!) trailer of our game.

Feel free to check it out - and enjoy!

[previewyoutube=Lcd4NibiQzY;full][/previewyoutube]

Any thoughts or comments? Don't hesitate to share them with us in the comments or on our social media channels! 

Well, that is not all...

We also took part in the GamesRadar's Future Games Show 2021 which took place at the end of August. We presented new, never seen before fragments of gameplay from the A Wake Inn: Rebooked. You have to see what we are preparing for all of you!

[previewyoutube=BJpw8a43jqs;full][/previewyoutube]

OK, that's all.
For now...

We will keep you updated with any future announcements: here and on our social media - so you better not close your eyes...


--
Take care (and stay healthy!)
VRBros
